task.title: Port the pull request engine
task.body:
Read and write pull request files as Genbeya does. See [[Architecture#engines]].

- [ ] Parse topics, code ranges, suggestions, to-dos, replies and verdicts; flag unreadable lines
- [ ] Append replies and verdicts; tick to-dos; new pull request file with the next ID
- [ ] Effective approvals and **Ready to merge?** from the policy (`requiredApprovals`, `todosBlockMerge`)
- [ ] The change ID, with conformance cases that compare it with the desktop's on the same branches; if libgit2's diff can't match Git's, decide how to show it (see [[Roadmap#risks]])
- [ ] "Recorded, not verified": compare the verdict's name with the committer
